race.comment: CELESTIAL BLUE (3) finished second on debut, beaten a nose over 1125m at Geelong, and has not been produced since. In the placings in a recent Pakenham trial. Has a low draw and is expected to go well again. RESONANT (6) came home strongly last start to finish second, beaten a neck, over 1000m at Pakenham Synthetic when coming back from a spell. Can measure up. MERITORIOUS (4) turned in a solid run on debut last start, beaten 1.5 lengths into third at this track over 1000m. Likely improver so he should be in the finish. PERFECT DISMOUNT (5) was second up last start and went close, beaten a nose into second at Geelong over 1247m. Has good early toe so he should be handy in the run. Can feature in the finish. SCOVILLE (12) is one of the few who come through the race here won by the smart Aroused and she was the first of them home and draws to advantage.
